name: B10-0424/2026 – After § 1 – Am 60
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: 1c. Calls on the High Representative to propose to the Council that the Muslim Brotherhood be included in the EU terrorist list; consequently, calls on the Council to include the Muslim Brotherhood in the terrorist list during the next review thereof;
